houseInfo.Placidus: The most common system. Divides the houses into different widths based on birth time and latitude.
houseInfo.Whole Sign: An ancient system. The entire rising sign counts as the 1st house, and each sign is one house.
houseInfo.Koch: Similar to Placidus, but more sensitive to the latitude of the birthplace.
houseInfo.Equal: Starts at the rising degree and divides every house into an equal 30 degrees.
houseInfo.Porphyry: Divides the space between the four angles into three equal parts. The default of some popular apps.

Ev & aile: A family member calls just as you were thinking of them. Even a neighbor waving from across the street feels warmer than usual today.
Small chores at home may take longer than they look. Don’t guess what someone expects from you, ask.
An old family topic may come back to the table. Listening without trying to be right keeps the house calmer today.
A quiet evening at home when nobody needs anything from you. Brew some tea and crack the window open.
Arkadaşlar: A friend is looking out for you today without you noticing. A small thank-you message changes both your days.
It feels like everyone wants something from you at once. Say yes to one plan and kindly say later to the rest.
A sentence in the group chat could be misunderstood. Read it once more before you send it.
Your friendships are in a calm place today. You have nothing to prove to anyone.
İş & para: Something you’ve waited for a long time is heading your way. Your first reaction may be doubt, so accept it this time.
The work on your desk is piling up. Cut your list down to three items and leave the rest for tomorrow.
A purchase may look sensible at first glance. Let the cart sit overnight.
A routine, quiet day at work. A good chance to collect your thoughts.
Aşk: You’re more attractive when you’re relaxed, and everyone sees it today. Don’t be shy about holding a glance a little longer.
Time can crawl while you wait for a reply. Leave your phone in another room for a while.
Your expectations may speak louder than your words today. Saying plainly what you want is less tiring than a guessing game.
Your heart is resting today. You can have a good day without calling anyone.

Ev & aile: There’s a peaceful mood at home, share it.
Chores may pile up, don’t hesitate to ask for help.
A disagreement with someone in the family could come up, talk without raising your voice.
Arkadaşlar: Your voice carries more in the group.
Don’t try to reach everyone, say yes to a single plan.
Plans with a friend may get tangled, stay flexible.
A calm day in your social life.
İş & para: Focus comes easily, finish the hard task now.
Deadlines may squeeze you, shorten your list.
Think twice about your spending today.
Aşk: You’re relaxed and attractive, don’t hide it.
Don’t overanalyze, stay in the flow.
Düşünce: Your ideas are flowing, write them down.
Too many ideas at once, pick one.
Focusing may be hard, take short breaks.
Ruhsal: Finding time for yourself is hard, five minutes is enough.
An old feeling may surface, be gentle with yourself.

daily.h: Going slowly today will save you time.
daily.b: With the Moon {{ay}}, your attention can scatter easily. Don’t move on to something new before finishing what’s in your hands. A short, honest conversation with someone toward evening could be the best moment of your day.
daily.s: The patience you show yourself is your strongest side today.
daily.x: Finish that one task you’ve been postponing before noon.

daily.h: A draft of what you want to say is already ready.
daily.b: Mercury is stirring up your communication. Write down the sentence you’ve been composing in your head, then read it aloud once. Being open will serve you better today than being perfect.
daily.s: You don’t have to wait for the right moment to say how you feel.
daily.x: Don’t beat around the bush, say what you want directly.

daily.h: A small bit of order brings great relief.
daily.b: Because the Moon is {{ay}}, home and daily routine may draw your attention more. Tidying a drawer, paying a bill, or making one plan for tomorrow will lighten your mind.
daily.s: Every small thing you do today counts.
daily.x: Stop using the mess as an excuse, give it ten minutes.

daily.h: Your curiosity can lead you to the right person.
daily.b: Jupiter is supporting your social sphere. A good day to write to someone you haven’t talked to in a long time or to speak up in a new group. Asking questions will open more doors for you today than giving answers.
daily.s: If you take the first step, nobody will judge you.

daily.h: Your energy is short but intense today.
daily.b: Mars is making an aspect to your rising sign. It’s good to finish the heavy work in the morning and keep the afternoon light. Do something good for your body in the evening. A walk, some stretching or an early night is enough.
daily.s: Resting is part of being productive too.
daily.x: Don’t spend your energy on pointless arguments.

daily.h: Setting a boundary protects your relationship.
daily.b: Saturn wants you to be clear in the area of relationships. Defending the time you set aside for yourself isn’t selfishness. A kind no earns more respect than a reluctant yes.
daily.s: Protecting yourself is also a way of protecting the people you love.
daily.x: Don’t try to please everyone, protect your own plan.

daily.h: Your intuition is working fast today.
daily.b: The Moon {{ay}} is making a harmonious aspect to Neptune. When you make a decision, note your first feeling and look at it again in the evening. Dreams and small coincidences may tell you more today.
daily.s: You don’t need permission to trust your inner voice.
daily.x: Don’t ignore what you feel, but don’t rush either.

daily.h: Finishing something today will feel really good.
daily.b: Venus is lighting up your area of effort. Completing an unfinished project, a book or a correspondence will give you more satisfaction than you expect.
daily.s: Congratulate yourself for everything you finish.
daily.x: Close one item from the list you left half-done today.

Go with the flow.
XI

XII

Waiting, seeing from a different angle.
Needless sacrifice.
Don’t rush, change your perspective.
XIII
Death

Resisting change.
Let go of something that no longer serves you.
XIV

Middle path, patience, harmony.
Excess.
Find the measure.
XV

Habits that hold you.

XVI

Stay flexible toward the unexpected.
XVII
The Star
Hope, healing, inspiration.
Exhaustion, losing hope.
Write a small wish for the future.
XVIII
The Moon
Uncertainty, dreams, intuition.
Confusion clearing.
Note down your dreams.
XIX
The Sun
Joy, openness, success.
Passing clouds.
Share a joy with someone you love.
XX
Judgement
Answering a call, rebirth.
Judging yourself too harshly.
Listen to a call you’ve been putting off.
XXI
The World
Completion, wholeness.
Getting stuck on the last step.
Celebrate a cycle.
